notes.title: Update for Mac
notes.notes:
Generals,

We would like to inform you about the release of a fresh update for the Mac version of the game.

We have fixed the issue, which caused the following error: "Insufficient memory to start application. Not enough memory to begin loading s3e file."

https://store.steampowered.com/app/338130/Strategy__Tactics_Wargame_Collection/

Good luck in upcoming battles!

notes.title: Patch is here!
notes.notes:
Generals,

We have another patch rolled out for you.

[h1]What's new:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Animation speed of national flags on global map is decreased;
[*]RMB to move camera on map and LMB to move units;
[*]Several minor tweaks and big fixes.
[/list]

Enjoy!

:rstar:
